sources.title: GitHub - ASKabalan/infrared-cloud-detection: Deep-learning architecture ...
sources.snippet: Deep-learning architecture classifies and identifies cloud structure in sky infrared images. A standard Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) distinguishes clear sky images from cloud images. A UNet-based segmentation model detects cloud structure in pre-identified cloudy images and outputs a probabilistic map for each pixel.

Especially in quantitative analysis, the impact of cloud cover on the reliability of analysis results cannot be ignored.
